_about: THE FEED'S WORDS (WORDS lane, 10/26/26; VAMILY [the feed's words] rule 215(f) and [the usernames tell the story] rule 217). Every post the phone's FEED app can show, as rows a modder reads: a KIND is one sort of post (its trigger, who may post it, how often, how soon, the words with five or more variants, what it teaches); an ACCOUNT is a handle that tells who posts (217: a post is its handle and its words, the face field empty until faces exist). FEED owns the triggers, the pacing and its one data file and reads or copies these rows; the suggest block on each kind is WORDS' suggestion, never FEED's decision. Every line is draft:true (8/11). Built by tools/words_feed/build_feed_bank.py, never by hand; checked by gates/feed_words_gate.js. Record: records/BOHEMIA_WORDS_THE_FEED_TALKS_AND_THE_HANDLES_10_26_26.md.

how_to_speak.value: a variant has en (plain English, no Spanish word in it) and, often, es (its Spanglish twin). Pick the form per post with BohemiaSpanglish.regFor(account, kind id): 'en' takes en; anything else takes es when there is one, else BohemiaSpanglish.flavour(en, account). The dial is the house rate (10 to 15 in 100, rule 143a), so the bank holds the twins and never decides the share. The company page is the player (player:true) and a bot is a machine (machine:true): both always en, the dial skipped.

who.value: a kind's who is a list of pools, first match wins: town = a person whose home is the event's town (else valley), valley = any person, scanner = the scanner page, company = his page, stranger = a burner, faction:<id> = that faction's page (records/target/bb/factions.json ids), or an account id (sal, benny, yolanda, chuy, lyle, a bot).

faction_says.rule: {enemy} and {faction} are filled from here, always a plural, lower case; the lines are written with plural verbs to match

casing.value: a person writes in lower case and a fill keeps its own case inside it; a page's, the scanner's and the company's post opens every sentence with a capital, so when a fill opens one of their sentences its first letter is raised. {company} is his name without a leading "the" (the lines say "the {company}" where people would).

tags.heard: it reached the poster second hand (hop 1 or more)
tags.ah: the analog horror is in what they noticed (for EYES' read)
